title: Qualify root residual and Simpson regularity audit limits
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded root residual and Simpson regularity audits and close M6 W01 C02

contribution.summary: Qualify explicit residual and regularity audits over bounded Math root solving and Simpson integration. Recover a compiled missing-API RED, pass 50 GREENs, 44 retained C02 T1 and 108 retained C01 tests, plus two regressions. SHA-qualify real local analysis preview.4 with two independent source-free eight-probe NuGet consumers. Close T2 and C02 only; W01/M6, rigorous error theorems, public NuGet and downstream adoption remain open.
contribution.value: Prevent sign-jump or width-only bisection results from masquerading as small-residual roots; refuse Simpson observations without explicitly declared, unverified caller smoothness. Preserve existing numerical and curve APIs with typed nonpartial failures.
debtChanges: Observe one compiled missing-public-audit-API RED before staging new Math numerical source, then recover it alongside 50 independent GREEN scientific tests.
Refuse width-only bisection success when observed function residual exceeds caller tolerance, including discontinuous sign-jump and coarse-width adversarial cases.
Require an explicit, unverified smoothness assumption before admitting a composite Simpson estimate; never infer global error guarantees from finite sampling.
Use typed no-partial-output refusal for untrusted callbacks, nonfinite inputs, cancellation, missing brackets, budget and nonconvergence.
Retain the 44 qualified C02 T1 root/quadrature tests and all 108 C01 interpolation, spline and regression oracles unchanged.
Preserve BCL-only net10 library boundaries and run two relevant Math regression projects without routine full-solution certification.
Inspect one actual locally packed 1.1.0-preview.4 NuGet archive and prove identical bytes in new and retained distinct eight-probe source-free consumers.
Close C02-T2 R/G/V, T2 and phase C02 only; retain M6-W01 and M6 in progress, with C03 and public/downstream adoption unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS084 success, prepare M6-W01-C03-T1 for bounded numerical differentiation and small ODE integration with explicit step and error policy. Keep M6-W01/M6 open.

achievements.achievement: Observe a genuine compiled missing public numerical residual/regularity audit API RED against the qualified preceding package.
Implement typed nonpartial residual-qualified root and caller-assumed smoothness Simpson sidecar with 50 independent GREEN test oracles.
Preserve 152 prior focused tests, run two core Math regressions and verify one real local preview.4 nupkg by two separate eight-probe consumers.
Qualify numerical failure boundaries, explicit unverified regularity and residual-gated admission without claiming a rigorous root or integration error theorem.
Close T1 and T2 numerical roots/quadrature with independent RED/GREEN, retained tests and local package evidence; M6-W01/M6 remain open.
